question: In November 2024, who has been appointed as Chief of BrahMos Aerospace?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaiteerth Raghavendra Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Jaiteerth Raghavendra Joshi** has been appointed as the Chief of **BrahMos Aerospace** in **November 2024**, succeeding the previous officeholder.

• **BrahMos Aerospace** is a joint venture between **India's Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** and **Russia's NPO Mashinostroyenia (NPOM)**, known for developing the world-renowned supersonic cruise missile, BrahMos.

• Jaiteerth Raghavendra Joshi is an accomplished professional with expertise in **defense technology, strategic weapon systems, and management of aerospace projects**.

• The appointment of Joshi reflects India's strategic focus on modernizing its defense capabilities and strengthening its indigenous weapon systems production.

• Under his leadership, BrahMos Aerospace is expected to focus on **expanding its missile export markets** and developing advanced variants of the BrahMos missile.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **BrahMos Missile:**

• The **BrahMos** is a **supersonic cruise missile** developed jointly by India and Russia, named after the rivers Brahmaputra (India) and Moskva (Russia).

• It has a speed of up to **Mach 3** (three times the speed of sound) and a range of **approximately 450–500 km**.

• It can be launched from various platforms including **land, sea, air, and underwater**, making it a versatile weapon system.

• It is capable of carrying conventional warheads and is known for its **precision strike capability**.

• **BrahMos Aerospace:**

• BrahMos Aerospace was established in **1998** as a joint venture between India's DRDO and Russia's NPOM.

• It aims to design, develop, produce, and market advanced missile systems for India and other friendly nations.

• The organization is headquartered in **New Delhi, India**.

• **India’s Focus on Defense Exports:**

• India has been actively promoting the export of BrahMos missiles to friendly countries such as **Philippines, Vietnam, and Indonesia**.

• In **2022**, India signed a deal with the Philippines to export BrahMos missiles worth **$375 million**.

• **Key Features of BrahMos Missile:**

• The missile employs **stealth technology** to evade radar detection and has a very low radar cross-section.

• It has **fire-and-forget capability**, meaning it does not require further guidance after launch.

• The missile is powered by a **solid propellant booster engine** and a liquid ramjet engine, ensuring high speed and range.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Export Potential:** BrahMos has emerged as a key component of India's defense exports, with countries showing significant interest due to its **precision, versatility, and speed**.

• **Future Developments:** BrahMos Aerospace is working on **hypersonic variants** of the missile, which will have speeds exceeding **Mach 5**.

• **Strategic Importance:** The BrahMos missile enhances India's defense capabilities and acts as a **deterrent** against adversaries.
